package.name: navigation_system
package.description:
Package to handle wayfinding and route recording for DaVE We use waypoints to define places where we want the rover to go and we use obstacles to define regions we cannot traverse on the way there
the NAVnode uses a linked list for waypoints and a dynamic array for obstacles it allows for the creation of up to 5 preplanned routes for DaVE to take
It communuicates with GNSS to get out current position It also can do obstacle avoidance (for software defined obstacles) and will have a built in mini-map display
